`npx ctxcap@1.6.0 why` diagnoses repository context files and skills, names configured MCP servers, and finds stale or risky content.
Run it before and after context changes; fix stale references and review security findings.
When the total is over budget, `npx ctxcap@1.6.0 --plan --budget <n>` lists the line ranges to cut.
